survey: Stage spotlight hung from a short box truss. Truss: two top and two bottom aluminum tubes joined by diagonal lacing; it hangs free with both ends inside the frame, an acceptable card crop. A square clamp block sits on the front bottom tube, with a short vertical stem dropping to a U-shaped yoke. The yoke's right arm ends in a pivot knob on the side of the can; the left arm comes down behind the can (pivot hidden, plausible). Lamp: a dark cylinder tilted down-left toward the camera, with three LEDs (yellow, cyan, red) in the front face, plausible for an LED light; the coloured beams spread from the lens. The load path from truss to clamp, yoke, pivot and lamp is sound.

errors.where: Truss lacing between top and bottom chords
errors.what: Diagonals don't form a regular zigzag: some cross mid-span, the ends don't meet the chords at matching joints, and the front and back faces don't line up
Left arm ends against the top of the can with no pivot knob to match the right side, and its length doesn't quite match the right arm

fix: Aluminum box truss with a regular, evenly spaced zigzag of diagonal braces; each diagonal meets the top and bottom tubes at shared joints, and the front and back faces mirror each other. The U-shaped yoke has two arms of equal length, each ending in a matching pivot knob on opposite sides of the spotlight can.
